notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
A quick note about controller support: Steam's input system, while super flexible, tends to play havoc with games built with Unity.  If you're having trouble with the game recognizing your controller:

First of all, we apologize. We should have caught this earlier in development. We're working to fix it. 

Second, there's some workarounds you can try here in this post:

Controller Workarounds

First, try disconnecting your controller, and connecting it while the game is running.

Second, double-check your Steam Input settings (found in Big Picture Mode):

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34885911/da337e846c66a9e0fe65deb162f39547f92c91ef.png



Finally, check Vane's controller settings (found on the "manage game" button from Vane's entry in the Big Picture Library):
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34885911/1c01fa82c684885df131fe18602394bff6fd793f.png

As we work through this issue, we'll continue to update this post.

We apologize for this issue; you shouldn't have to resort to workarounds to enjoy your game.  While we should have thoroughly resolved this issue sooner, we'll keep working towards a workaround-free version in the meantime.

Thanks,
Friend & Foe Team
